Name: Instant Tool Upgrades For Costs
Author: N3xTcT
Description:
[u]Compatibility[/u]
[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6!
[/list]
[u]Installation[/u]
[list]
[*]Download and extract the contents of the .zip file into the Mods folder in your Stardew Valley installation folder.
[/list]
[u]About[/u]
[list]
[*]This is a redesigned mod that allows the player to receive updated tools for a small costs. You can get your item earlier if you pay more gold!
[*]You can change "SpeedBoostPriceMultiplier" in config.json
[*]Translations are supported via .json files in the i18n folder. Currently, two languages are supported: English and Russian.
[*]Works in single player. Not tested in multiplayer yet.
[*]Does not work on the phone version!

[/list]
[u]Credit[/u][list]
[*]I am grateful to @Binarynova for the work done link to the original mod : https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8918
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Tool Upgrades For Costs
Manifest.Description: The InstantToolUpgrades mod from the author Binarynova was used as a basis. This is a redesigned mod that allows the player to receive updated tools for a small fee. You can get your item earlier if you pay more gold!
